jobs.title: Betriebselektriker*in
jobs.description:
Über uns

Wir verzaubern die Welt mit Schokolade! Die Lindt & Sprüngli (Schweiz) AG ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der globalen Lindt & Sprüngli Gruppe mit Hauptsitz und Produktionsstätte in Kilchberg am Zürichsee. In Altendorf betreiben wir unser eigenes Logistikzentrum, während das Lindt Cocoa Center in Olten Kakaomasse für unseren Eigenbedarf sowie für andere europäische Produktionsstätten herstellt. In der ganzen Schweiz betreiben wir stolz 15 Lindt Shops, darunter ikonische Standorte wie das Jungfraujoch und das Verkehrshaus der Schweiz in Luzern. Über 1000 Mitarbeitende aus mehr als 50 Nationen tragen zu unserem Erfolg bei.

Was du bei uns machst:

• Störungssuche an den Anlagen sowie der Infrastruktur

• Durchführen von Unterhalts-, Revisions- und Umbauarbeiten

• Verantwortlich für Arbeiten an der Telefonanlage/-zentrale

• Verantwortlich für die Revision und Störungsbehebung

• Überwachen von Inbetriebsetzungen

• Unterstützen in der Lernendenausbildung

Wann du zu uns passt:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Betriebselektriker*in / Automatiker*in EFZ

• Weiterbildung zur/zum Techniker*in HF von Vorteil

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung zwingend

• Grundkenntnisse in der Netzwerktechnik

• Fundierte Automations- (Siemens S7 & TIA Portal) sowie Servotechnik-Erfahrung zwingend

• Bereitschaft für Pikettdienst sowie Schichtarbeit (3-Schicht)

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

• Selbstständiges, pflichtbewusstes und sorgfältiges Arbeiten

• Kommunikative sowie aufgestellte Persönlichkeit

Wir sind alle einzigartig!
Wir rekrutieren frei von Vorurteilen und berücksichtigen Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen unbeeinflusst von persönlichen Merkmalen wie Geschlecht, Alter, sexuelle Orientierung, Herkunft, Religion, Familienstand, Beeinträchtigungen, etc.

Wohlbefinden
Gesundheit ist uns wichtig. Mit einer Sportprämie, Ergonomieberatung, gesunder Ernährung und weiteren Gesundheitsinitiativen unterstützen wir dich dabei fit zu bleiben.

Entwicklung
Lernen wird bei uns GROSS geschrieben. Für die persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung stehen dir verschiedene spannende Möglichkeiten zur Verfügung.

Mobilität
Wir unterstützen dich mit einer monatlichen Mobilitätsprämie und E-Bikes vor Ort. Zudem kannst du auch von der REKA-Card profitieren.

Familienfreundliches Umfeld - richtig versichert
Unsere Sozialversicherungen, wie auch der Mutterschaftsurlaub, gehen weit über das Obligatorische hinaus - zum eigenen Schutz sowie für deine Liebsten.

Flexibilität
Je nach Funktion sind flexible Arbeitszeiten, Home Office sowie Teilzeitarbeit möglich. Zudem bieten wir dir die Option, die Ferientage zu erhöhen.

Vergünstigung
Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen wie ein top Personalrestaurant, Rabatte in den Lindt Shops oder tolle Freizeitangebote stehen dir zur Verfügung.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Su di noi

Lindt & Sprüngli (Svizzera) AG è una filiale del Gruppo mondiale Lindt & Sprüngli con sede e stabilimento produttivo a Kilchberg sul Lago di Zurigo. Ad Altendorf gestiamo un nostro centro logistico, mentre il Centro di cacao Lindt di Olten produce massa di cacao per le nostre esigenze e per altri impianti produttivi europei. In tutta la Svizzera operiamo con orgoglio 15 negozi Lindt, tra cui siti iconici come il Jungfraujoch e la società svizzera di trasporto pubblico a Lucarne.

Oltre 1000 dipendenti provenienti da più di 50 nazioni contribuiscono al nostro successo.

Cosa fai con noi:

- individuare guasti agli impianti e alle infrastrutture - effettuare lavori di manutenzione, revisione e trasformazione - svolgere lavori presso il sistema telefonico/ufficio centrale - provvedere alla revisione e alla risoluzione dei problemi - controllare la messa in servizio - sostenere la formazione dei lavoratori

Siamo tutti unici!

Reclutiamo senza pregiudizi e prendiamo in considerazione competenze e qualifiche senza incidere sulle caratteristiche personali quali sesso, età, orientamento sessuale, origine, religione, stato di salute, disabilità, ecc.

Benessere

La salute è importante per noi. Vi sosteniamo nel rimanere in forma con un premio sportivo, consulenza ergonomica, nutrizione sana e altre iniziative di salute.

Politica di sviluppo

L'apprendimento è scritto GRANDE con noi. Per lo sviluppo personale e professionale, avete varie possibilità emozionanti a vostra disposizione.

Mobilità

Vi sosteniamo con un bonus mensile di mobilità e biciclette elettroniche in loco. Potete anche beneficiare della carta REKA.

Ambiente familiare - correttamente assicurato

Le nostre prestazioni di sicurezza sociale, così come il congedo di maternità, vanno ben oltre l'obbligo - per la propria protezione e per i vostri cari.

Flessibilità

A seconda della funzione, orari di lavoro flessibili, ufficio a casa e lavoro a tempo parziale sono possibili. Offriamo anche la possibilità di aumentare i giorni di vacanza.

Prestazioni

Sono disponibili sconti per il personale, sconti per i negozi Lindt o grandi attività ricreative.
descriptionByLocale.en:
About us

We enchant the world with chocolate! Lindt & Sprüngli (Switzerland) AG is a subsidiary of the global Lindt & Sprüngli Group with its headquarters and production facility in Kilchberg on Lake Zurich. In Altendorf we operate our own logistics center, while the Lindt Cocoa Center in Olten produces cocoa mass for our own needs as well as for other European production facilities. Throughout Switzerland we proudly operate 15 Lindt shops, including iconic locations such as the Jungfraujoch and the Swiss public transport company in Lucerne.

Over 1000 employees from more than 50 nations contribute to our success.

What you do with us:

- finding faults on the facilities and infrastructure - carrying out maintenance, revision and conversion work - responsible for work at the telephone system/central office - responsible for the revision and troubleshooting - monitoring of commissioning - supporting in the training of learners

When you fit in with us:

- Completed training as an employee in the company electrician/automatist/en-fachist - Continuing training to/from technician/en-fachister/en-fachister/en-fachistiger/en-fachistiger/en-fachister/en-fachister/en-fachistier/en-fachistier/en-fachistier/en-fachistier/en-fachistier/en-fachistier/en-fachistier/en-fachistier/en-fachistier/en-fachistier/en-fachievement/en-fachistier/en-fachistier/en-fachievement/en-fachievement/en-fachist/en-fachievement/en-en-fachte-en-fach-en-en-fach-fach-en-en-en-fach-en-en-

We are all unique!

We recruit free of prejudices and take into account skills and qualifications without affecting personal characteristics such as gender, age, sexual orientation, origin, religion, marital status, impairments, etc.

Wellness

Health is important to us. We support you in staying fit with a sports premium, ergonomics consulting, healthy nutrition and other health initiatives.

Development

Learning is written GREAT with us. For personal and professional development, you have various exciting possibilities at your disposal.

Mobility

We support you with a monthly mobility bonus and e-bikes on site. You can also benefit from the REKA card.

Family friendly environment - correctly insured

Our social security benefits, as well as maternity leave, go far beyond the mandatory - for your own protection and for your loved ones.

Flexibility

Depending on the function, flexible working hours, home office and part-time work are possible. We also offer you the option to increase the holiday days.

Benefits

Numerous discounts such as a top staff restaurant, discounts in the Lindt shops or great leisure activities are available.

À propos de nous

Lindt & Sprüngli (Suisse) AG est une filiale du groupe mondial Lindt & Sprüngli avec son siège et son usine de production à Kilchberg sur le lac de Zurich. A Altendorf, nous exploitons notre propre centre logistique, tandis que le Lindt Cocoa Center à Olten produit une masse de cacao pour nos propres besoins ainsi que pour d'autres installations de production européennes.

Plus de 1000 employés de plus de 50 pays contribuent à notre succès.

Ce que vous faites de nous :

- trouver des défauts sur les installations et infrastructures - effectuer des travaux de maintenance, de révision et de conversion - assurer le travail au système téléphonique/au bureau central - assurer la révision et le dépannage - contrôler la mise en service - soutenir la formation des apprenants

Quand vous vous installez avec nous:

- Formation continue en tant qu'employé dans l'entreprise électricien/automatiste/en-fachiste - Formation continue en/du technicien/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste/en-fachiste-en-fach-en-fach-en-fach-fach-fach-en-en-en-fach-en-en-fach-en-fach-en-en-fach-en-fach

Nous sommes tous uniques!

Nous recrutons sans préjugés et prenons en compte les compétences et les qualifications sans affecter les caractéristiques personnelles telles que le sexe, l'âge, l'orientation sexuelle, l'origine, la religion, l'état matrimonial, les déficiences, etc.

Bien-être

La santé est importante pour nous. Nous vous soutenons dans votre maintien en forme avec une prime sportive, des conseils ergonomiques, une nutrition saine et d'autres initiatives de santé.

Développement

L'apprentissage est écrit GRAND avec nous. Pour le développement personnel et professionnel, vous avez diverses possibilités passionnantes à votre disposition.

Mobilité

Nous vous accompagnons avec un bonus mensuel de mobilité et des vélos électroniques sur place. Vous pouvez également bénéficier de la carte REKA.

Environnement familial - correctement assuré

Nos prestations de sécurité sociale, ainsi que le congé de maternité, vont bien au-delà de l'obligation - pour votre propre protection et pour vos proches.

Flexibilité

Selon la fonction, des horaires flexibles, des bureaux à domicile et des heures de travail à temps partiel sont possibles. Nous vous proposons également la possibilité d'augmenter les jours de congé.

Avantages

De nombreuses réductions comme un restaurant haut de gamme, des réductions dans les magasins Lindt ou de grandes activités de loisirs sont disponibles.

descriptionByLocale.en:
About us

We enchant the world with chocolate! Lindt & Sprüngli (Switzerland) AG is a subsidiary of the global Lindt & Sprüngli Group with its headquarters and production facility in Kilchberg on Lake Zurich. In Altendorf we operate our own logistics center, while the Lindt Cocoa Center in Olten produces cocoa mass for our own needs as well as for other European production facilities. Throughout Switzerland we proudly operate 15 Lindt shops, including iconic locations such as the Jungfraujoch and the Swiss public transport company in Lucerne.

Over 1000 employees from more than 50 nations contribute to our success.

Tasks

- Provision and reporting of production orders, raw and semi-finished products and finished products using SAP/R3 - Controlling, correcting and mutating time recording using SAP/R3 (TimeTool) - Controlling and coordinating the stock of materials - Supporting the introduction of temporary employees - Assistance with LAW; compliance with order and cleanliness in the office (5S) - Office activities as ordered by the Head of Division - Replacement and relocation of machine and plant managers - Monthly tool control of personnel and plants - General

administrative activities - initiating and managing small projects

Requirements

- Completed commercial training or training as a plant manager*in EFZ or food technologist*login EFZ with experience in commercial field - multi-year professional experience at L&S - Very good German knowledge, good English knowledge (of advantage) - Very good PC knowledge (Word/Excel/PowePoint) - SAP knowledge (of advantage) - initiative, established and resilient personality with organizational talent

We are all unique!

We recruit free of prejudices and take into account skills and qualifications without affecting personal characteristics such as gender, age, sexual orientation, origin, religion, marital status, impairments, etc.

Development - Learning is written GROSS. For personal and professional development, you have various exciting possibilities at your disposal.

Mobility - We support you with a monthly mobility bonus and e-bikes on site. You can also benefit from the REKA card.

Family friendly environment - properly insured - Our social security benefits, as well as maternity leave, go far beyond the mandatory - for your own protection as well as for your loved ones.

Flexibility - Flexible working hours, home office and part-time work are possible depending on the function. We also offer you the option to increase the holidays.

Discount - Numerous discounts such as a top staff restaurant, discounts in the Lindt shops or great leisure activities are available.

jobs.title: Unsolicited Application
jobs.description:
We enchant the World with Chocolate - Shape the Future with Us!

Join Lindt & Sprüngli and become part of a company where passion, quality and entrepreneurial spirit come together.
We are always interested in meeting talented individuals who are eager to contribute their expertise, bring fresh perspectives and grow with us. Whether your background is in business, marketing, supply chain, finance, HR or another specialist area, we welcome proactive applications from people who share our commitment to excellence and our passion for creating exceptional experiences. If you would like to be part of an international, dynamic and purpose-driven environment, we look forward to hearing from you.

What you can contribute
As part of our international environment, you may have the opportunity to:

• Contribute your expertise to impactful projects and business initiatives

• Bring ideas to continuously improve our ways of working

• Collaborate across functions, markets, and cultures

• Take ownership of your responsibilities and drive results with a hands-on mindset

• Support the delivery of premium products and exceptional brand experiences

What we are looking for
We are interested in individuals who demonstrate:

• A strong sense of ownership, accountability, and initiative

• Passion for quality, excellence, and continuous improvement

• A collaborative mindset and strong communication skills

• Curiosity, adaptability, and openness to learning

• Professional experience or academic background relevant to your field of interest

• Fluency in English (additional languages are an asset in our international environment)

Note: This posting does not refer to a specific open position. Your application will be kept on file, and we will contact you as soon as a suitable position becomes available that matches your qualifications and professional experience. We do not accept CVs from executive search companies and headhunters.

Über uns

Wir verzaubern die Welt mit Schokolade! Die Lindt & Sprüngli (Schweiz) AG ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der globalen Lindt & Sprüngli Gruppe mit Hauptsitz und Produktionsstätte in Kilchberg am Zürichsee. In Altendorf betreiben wir unser eigenes Logistikzentrum, während das Lindt Cocoa Center in Olten Kakaomasse für unseren Eigenbedarf sowie für andere europäische Produktionsstätten herstellt. In der ganzen Schweiz betreiben wir stolz 15 Lindt Shops, darunter ikonische Standorte wie das Jungfraujoch und das Verkehrshaus der Schweiz in Luzern. Über 1000 Mitarbeitende aus mehr als 50 Nationen tragen zu unserem Erfolg bei.

Was du bei uns machst:

• Erstklassige Verkaufsberatung unserer internationalen Kundschaft

• Merchandising der Verkaufsregale (inklusive Frischekontrollen)

• Bedienung der Kasse

• Mithilfe bei der Lagerführung

• Erstellung von Abrechnungen
Wann du zu uns passt:

• Abgeschlossene Detailhandelsausbildung und/oder Erfahrung in ähnlichen, vor allem dienstleistungsorientierten Brachen, wie Gastronomie und Hotellerie

• Überzeugende Verkaufspersönlichkeit mit einer hohen Kundenorientierung

• Zeitlich flexibel und bereit, auch Wochenendeinsätze zu übernehmen

• Fliessende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere Sprachen von Vorteil

• Teamfähige, engagierte und offene Persönlichkeit

• Leidenschaft für unsere Premium-Schokolade und für die Liebe zum Detail

Wir sind alle einzigartig!

Wir rekrutieren frei von Vorurteilen und berücksichtigen Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen unbeeinflusst von persönlichen Merkmalen wie Geschlecht, Alter, sexuelle Orientierung, Herkunft, Religion, Familienstand, Beeinträchtigungen, etc.

Wohlbefinden
Gesundheit ist uns wichtig. Mit einer Sportprämie, Ergonomieberatung, gesunder Ernährung und weiteren Gesundheitsinitiativen unterstützen wir dich dabei fit zu bleiben.

Entwicklung
Lernen wird bei uns GROSS geschrieben. Für die persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung stehen dir verschiedene spannende Möglichkeiten zur Verfügung.

Mobilität
Wir unterstützen dich mit einer monatlichen Mobilitätsprämie und E-Bikes vor Ort. Zudem kannst du auch von der REKA-Card profitieren.

Familienfreundliches Umfeld - richtig versichert
Unsere Sozialversicherungen, wie auch der Mutterschaftsurlaub, gehen weit über das Obligatorische hinaus - zum eigenen Schutz sowie für deine Liebsten.

Flexibilität
Je nach Funktion sind flexible Arbeitszeiten, Home Office sowie Teilzeitarbeit möglich. Zudem bieten wir dir die Option, die Ferientage zu erhöhen.

Vergünstigung
Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen wie ein top Personalrestaurant, Rabatte in den Lindt Shops oder tolle Freizeitangebote stehen dir zur Verfügung.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Su di noi

Lindt & Sprüngli (Svizzera) AG è una filiale del Gruppo mondiale Lindt & Sprüngli con sede e stabilimento produttivo a Kilchberg sul Lago di Zurigo. Ad Altendorf gestiamo un nostro centro logistico, mentre il Centro di cacao Lindt di Olten produce massa di cacao per le nostre esigenze e per altri impianti produttivi europei. In tutta la Svizzera operiamo con orgoglio 15 negozi Lindt, tra cui siti iconici come il Jungfraujoch e la società svizzera di trasporto pubblico a Lucarne.

Oltre 1000 dipendenti provenienti da più di 50 nazioni contribuiscono al nostro successo.

Cosa fai con noi:

- consulenza commerciale di prima classe per i nostri clienti internazionali - merchandising degli scaffali di vendita (compresi i controlli freschi) - gestione del registro cassa - assistenza nella gestione delle scorte - preparazione delle fatture

Quando ti trovi in mezzo a noi:

- Formazione completa e/o esperienza in aree simili, soprattutto orientate ai servizi, come gastronomia e industria alberghiera - Personalità di vendita convincente con un alto orientamento al cliente - Temporary flessibile e pronto a prendere il sopravvento anche nei weekend - Scorrendo competenze tedesche e buone inglese, altre lingue di vantaggio - Personalità Team-enabled, impegnata e aperta - Passione per il nostro cioccolato premium e per la cura dei dettagli

Siamo tutti unici!

Reclutiamo senza pregiudizi e prendiamo in considerazione competenze e qualifiche senza incidere sulle caratteristiche personali quali sesso, età, orientamento sessuale, origine, religione, stato di salute, disabilità, ecc.

Benessere

La salute è importante per noi. Vi sosteniamo nel rimanere in forma con un premio sportivo, consulenza ergonomica, nutrizione sana e altre iniziative di salute.

Politica di sviluppo

L'apprendimento è scritto GRANDE con noi. Per lo sviluppo personale e professionale, avete varie possibilità emozionanti a vostra disposizione.

Mobilità

Vi sosteniamo con un bonus mensile di mobilità e biciclette elettroniche in loco. Potete anche beneficiare della carta REKA.

Ambiente familiare - correttamente assicurato

Le nostre prestazioni di sicurezza sociale, così come il congedo di maternità, vanno ben oltre l'obbligo - per la propria protezione e per i vostri cari.

Flessibilità

A seconda della funzione, orari di lavoro flessibili, ufficio a casa e lavoro a tempo parziale sono possibili. Offriamo anche la possibilità di aumentare i giorni di vacanza.

Prestazioni

Sono disponibili sconti per il personale, sconti per i negozi Lindt o grandi attività ricreative.
descriptionByLocale.en:
About us

We enchant the world with chocolate! Lindt & Sprüngli (Switzerland) AG is a subsidiary of the global Lindt & Sprüngli Group with its headquarters and production facility in Kilchberg on Lake Zurich. In Altendorf we operate our own logistics center, while the Lindt Cocoa Center in Olten produces cocoa mass for our own needs as well as for other European production facilities. Throughout Switzerland we proudly operate 15 Lindt shops, including iconic locations such as the Jungfraujoch and the Swiss public transport company in Lucerne.

Over 1000 employees from more than 50 nations contribute to our success.

What you do with us:

- First-class sales advice for our international customers - merchandising of the sales shelves (including fresh controls) - handling of the cash register - assistance in the management of the stock - preparation of invoices

When you fit in with us:

- Completed retail training and/or experience in similar, above all service-oriented areas, such as gastronomy and hotel industry - Convincing sales personality with a high customer orientation - Timely flexible and ready to take over also weekend trips - Flowing German and good English skills, other languages of advantage - Team-enabled, committed and open personality - Passion for our premium chocolate and for the attention to detail

We are all unique!

We recruit free of prejudices and take into account skills and qualifications without affecting personal characteristics such as gender, age, sexual orientation, origin, religion, marital status, impairments, etc.

Wellness

Health is important to us. We support you in staying fit with a sports premium, ergonomics consulting, healthy nutrition and other health initiatives.

Development

Learning is written GREAT with us. For personal and professional development, you have various exciting possibilities at your disposal.

Mobility

We support you with a monthly mobility bonus and e-bikes on site. You can also benefit from the REKA card.

Family friendly environment - correctly insured

Our social security benefits, as well as maternity leave, go far beyond the mandatory - for your own protection and for your loved ones.

Flexibility

Depending on the function, flexible working hours, home office and part-time work are possible. We also offer you the option to increase the holiday days.

Benefits

Numerous discounts such as a top staff restaurant, discounts in the Lindt shops or great leisure activities are available.

Over 1000 employees from more than 50 nations contribute to our success.

• You check the quality and quantity of raw materials delivered

• You produce products according to recipes on modern plants

• You control the products and get samples

• You monitor and control our production facilities

• You accompany the production of fine chocolate products

• You bring in ideas to make our processes even better

When you fit in with us

• You are a *e good *r sec. A-student*in or very good *r sec. B-student*in

• You are interested in food and its composition

• Science and technology fascinate you

• You love machines, controls and modern high-tech systems

• Hygiene and cleanliness are a matter of course for you

• You have a good sense of aromas and fine taste nuances

• Getting up early is no problem for you – work starts at 06.30

Lindt & Sprüngli (Switzerland) AG is a subsidiary of the global Lindt & Sprüngli Group with headquarters and production facilities in Kilchberg on Lake Zurich. In Altendorf we operate our own logistics centre, while the Lindt Cocoa Center in Olten produces cocoa mass for our own use as well as for other European production facilities. Throughout Switzerland, we proudly operate 15 Lindt shops, including iconic locations such as the Jungfraujoch and the Swiss Transport House in Lucerne. More than 1000 employees from more than 50 nations contribute to our success. Shape tomorrow’s purchasing – strategically, digitally and with a measurable impact. You are a strong personality with negotiation skills, strategic thinking skills and the aspiration to implement things consistently? You not only want to manage, but actively shape, change and create added value? Then you are exactly right with us. In this key position, you are responsible for indirect purchasing and lead a dedicated procurement team. You will develop future-oriented procurement strategies, realize sustainable savings and consistently advance the digitalization of our purchasing processes. What you do with us:
• Development and implementation of corporate and category strategies for indirect purchasing
• Identification and realization of sustainable savings and value enhancement potential along the entire source-to-contract process
• Conduct complex national and international negotiations and conclude strategically important contracts
• Establishment, development and management of high-performance supplier partnerships
• Introduction and consistent use of modern digital procurement and analysis tools
• Further development of purchasing processes, governance structures and compliance requirements
• Analysis of procurement markets, risks, innovations and cost developments to derive strategic recommendations for action
• Leadership, coaching and further development of a procurement team
• Close cooperation with internal stakeholders at all levels of the company to implement procurement initiatives When you fit in with us:
• Several years of successful leadership experience in strategic purchasing, ideally in an industrial or manufacturing environment
• Demonstrate track record in demanding negotiations as well as in the implementation of significant savings and value enhancement programs
• Strong strategic expertise and experience in category management, supplier relationship management and total cost of ownership (TCO)
• High implementation strength and the ability to actively drive change and anchor it in the company
• Enthusiasm for digitalization and experience in the introduction or Further development of procurement systems and digital processes (e.g. SAP, Coupa, Analytics solutions)
• Sovereign appearance and the ability to communicate and influence convincingly at different management levels
• Entrepreneurial thinking, self-initiative and a strong focus on results
• Analytical strength combined with pragmatism and hands-on mentality
• Negotiable knowledge of German and English We are looking for a leader with strategic foresight, clear performance orientation and the will to implement change. Someone who wins negotiations, develops people, drives modern tools and positions purchasing as a real value driver. In short: A leader personality with a strong negotiating card, digital mindset and the ambition to develop indirect purchasing sustainably. We are all unique! • Forte comprensione del processo e l'esperienza nella preparazione di documenti di formazione e di lavoro

• Alto servizio e orientamento al cliente e una forte consapevolezza di qualità

• Metodo di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione

• Personalità comunicativa e di squadra capace con mentalità hands-on

• Gestione sicura di MS Office (Word, Excel e PowerPoint)

La salute è importante per noi. Con un bonus sportivo, consigli ergonomici, nutrizione sana e altre iniziative di salute, ti aiutiamo a rimanere in forma.

Imparare è scritto GRANDE con noi. Per lo sviluppo personale e professionale, diverse possibilità emozionanti sono a vostra disposizione.

A seconda della funzione, ore di lavoro flessibili, ufficio domestico e lavoro part-time sono possibili. Vi offriamo anche la possibilità di aumentare i giorni di vacanza.

Numerosi vantaggi come un ristorante di alto livello, sconti nei negozi Lindt o grandi offerte di svago sono a vostra disposizione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
About us

We enchant the world with chocolate! Lindt & Sprüngli (Switzerland) AG is a subsidiary of the global Lindt & Sprüngli Group with headquarters and production facilities in Kilchberg on Lake Zurich. In Altendorf we operate our own logistics centre, while the Lindt Cocoa Center in Olten produces cocoa mass for our own use as well as for other European production facilities. Throughout Switzerland, we proudly operate 15 Lindt shops, including iconic locations such as the Jungfraujoch and the Swiss Transport House in Lucerne. More than 1000 employees from more than 50 nations contribute to our success.

What you do with us:

• Support of the Head of Operations in all operational topics for the optimization of processes, standards and processes in our Lindt shops

• First contact person for the shops for operational issues and support in the implementation of operating standards

• Preparation, maintenance and further development of work instructions, manuals and training materials

• Planning, implementation and coordination of training and training for shop employees

• Participation in the implementation of new processes, systems and operational initiatives

• Identification and implementation of optimization potential in existing processes

• Support for cross-divisional projects in the area of Store Operations

• Ensuring compliance with quality, safety and hygiene standards

When you fit us

• Completed training in the retail trade, gastronomy, hotel industry or a comparable environment

• Mind. 3 years of professional experience in the retail, food or catering environment

• Strong process understanding as well as experience in the preparation of training and working documents

• High service and customer orientation as well as a strong quality awareness

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented working method

• Communicative and team capable personality with hands-on mentality

• Secure handling of MS Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)

• Very good knowledge of German and English, French or Italian is advantageous

• Passion for retail, chocolate and the brand Lindt

We are all unique!

We recruit free from prejudice and consider skills and qualifications unaffected by personal characteristics such as gender, age, sexual orientation, origin, religion, marital status, impairments, etc.

Health
Health is important to us. With a sports bonus, ergonomics advice, healthy nutrition and other health initiatives, we support you to stay fit.

Development
Learning is written BIG with us. For personal and professional development, various exciting possibilities are available to you.

Mobility
We support you with a monthly mobility bonus and e-bikes on site. You can also benefit from the REKA-Card.

Family-friendly environment - properly insured
Our social insurance, as well as maternity leave, goes far beyond the mandatory - for your own protection and for your loved ones.

Flexibility
Depending on the function, flexible working hours, home office and part-time work are possible. We also offer you the option to increase the holiday days.

Advantage
Numerous perks such as a top staff restaurant, discounts in the Lindt shops or great leisure offers are at your disposal.

jobs.title: Senior Manager Consolidation and FP&A
jobs.description:
Group Consolidation & Reporting

• Lead the financial and non-financial consolidation at Group level

• Ensure the accurate calculation of consolidation-related items (e.g. non-controlling interests, intercompany investments, currency translation adjustments)

• Safeguard the integrity of the Group cash flow statement and segment reporting

• Coordinate and implement IFRS updates in close collaboration with the IFRS team

• Manage and optimise changes to the Group’s reporting structure

EPM System Ownership (Tagetik)

• Drive the ongoing development and enhancement of the Group’s consolidation system (Tagetik)

• Act as system owner, ensuring smooth operation and providing user support during closing cycles

• Design and maintain input templates within the system for the collection of financial and non-financial data

Management & Board Reporting

• Prepare high-quality internal reports for senior management and the Board of Directors

• Align reporting outputs with evolving business requirements and stakeholder expectations

• Support sustainability reporting and related disclosures

FP&A Reporting

• Ensure completeness and quality of budget and forecast data submissions

• Validate budget and year-end forecast figures

• Provide insightful management reporting on budgeting and forecasting processes

Your Profile

• University degree in Finance, Accounting or Business Administration

• Professional certification such as Swiss Certified Public Accountant or Swiss Expert in Accounting & Controlling (or equivalent)

• 6–10 years of relevant professional experience in group reporting, consolidation or a similar role

• Strong expertise in IFRS and year-end closing processes

• Advanced knowledge of EPM systems (e.g. Tagetik, Cognos Controller, Hyperion)

• Highly self-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership and results orientation

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions and seniority levels

• Strong analytical and conceptual thinking, combined with sound business acumen

• Fluency in English (written and spoken); German is an advantage

descriptionByLocale.en:
About us

We enchant the world with chocolate! Lindt & Sprüngli (Schweiz) AG is a subsidiary of the global Lindt & Sprüngli Group with headquarters and production facilities in Kilchberg on Lake Zurich. We operate our own logistics center in Altendorf, while the Lindt Cocoa Center in Olten produces cocoa mass for our own use and for other European production facilities. We proudly operate 15 Lindt Shops across Switzerland, including iconic locations such as the Jungfraujoch and the Swiss Museum of Transport in Lucerne. Over 1,000 employees from more than 50 nations contribute to our success.

What you do with us:

• Independent planning and implementation of technical investment projects (including adapting or converting existing packaging systems or components). Format parts, sensors, gluing devices, vision systems (data matrix)

• Management of projects to increase the efficiency of packaging systems

• Evaluation of new packaging systems or components

• Estimating necessary adjustments to packaging systems and budgeting costs

• Technical feasibility test or evaluation for industrialization for new packaging concepts on existing packaging systems

• Support or carry out test runs when changing suppliers or to optimize existing packaging concepts

• Finding technical solutions for the use of new materials on existing systems (Sustainable Packaging Initiative)

• Supporting the installation and commissioning of purchased machines or modifications to packaging machines in the factory

• Support with operator and maintenance training in the packaging area

• Know-how transfer engineering/maintenance

When you're right for us:

• Completed studies at HF/FH or university/ETH level in packaging technology, process engineering, mechanical engineering or a comparable field

• At least 3 years of professional experience in a comparable position

• Experience in managing projects in the food industry

• Knowledge of lean manufacturing and TPM (Total Productive Management), especially early management

• Very good knowledge of German (mother tongue or business fluent)

• Good knowledge of spoken and written English

• Confident use of drawing programs (e.g. AutoCAD)

We are all unique!

We recruit without prejudice and take skills and qualifications into account without being influenced by personal characteristics such as gender, age, sexual orientation, origin, religion, marital status, impairments, etc.

well-being
Health is important to us. We support you in staying fit with a sports bonus, ergonomic advice, healthy nutrition and other health initiatives.

Development
Learning is very important to us. There are various exciting opportunities available to you for personal and professional development.

Mobility
We support you with a monthly mobility bonus and e-bikes on site. You can also benefit from the REKA card.

Family-friendly environment - properly insured
Our social insurance, like maternity leave, goes far beyond what is mandatory - to protect yourself and your loved ones.

Flexibility
Depending on the function, flexible working hours, home office and part-time work are possible. We also offer you the option to increase the number of vacation days.

Discount
Numerous benefits such as a top staff restaurant, discounts in the Lindt shops or great leisure activities are available to you.

descriptionByLocale.en:
About us

We enchant the world with chocolate! Lindt & Sprüngli (Switzerland) AG is a subsidiary of the global Lindt & Sprüngli Group with its headquarters and production facility in Kilchberg on Lake Zurich. In Altendorf we operate our own logistics center, while the Lindt Cocoa Center in Olten produces cocoa mass for our own needs as well as for other European production facilities. Throughout Switzerland we proudly operate 15 Lindt shops, including iconic locations such as the Jungfraujoch and the Swiss public transport company in Lucerne.

Over 1000 employees from more than 50 nations contribute to our success.

What you do with us:

- Conceptual responsibility for business and product-specific processes relevant to VAT at home and abroad (including

in the areas of domestic, retail, inter-company, global travel retail and international distribution companies) - preparation of VAT invoices in Switzerland and abroad (Switzerland, Belgium) and implementation of sales and pre-tax agreements - coordination with external VAT service providers with regard to the recovery of pre-tax payments from third countries - contact person for VAT checks (technical monitoring, data processing etc.) - determination of VAT rates for goods calculations - examination of electronic assessment orders and BAZG invoices - responsibility for the

Provision of statistical indicators to authorities - Technical support for cross-departmental projects and processes (incl.

Implementation in SAP) - Preparation of evaluations and statistics for Saharan financial statements (monthly and annual accounts) and cooperation with audits - Monitoring and further development of the VAT processes including maintenance and updating of process and ICS documentation

When you fit in with us:

- Commercial training with further training in financial and accounting (e.g. specialist card) - Multi-year experience in financial accounting with a focus on VAT - Very good SAP skills and a strong understanding of the process - Good English skills in word and writing - Self-employed, structured working methods and high self-initiative - Team skills and strong communication skills

We are all unique!

We recruit free of prejudices and take into account skills and qualifications without affecting personal characteristics such as gender, age, sexual orientation, origin, religion, marital status, impairments, etc.

Wellness

Health is important to us. We support you in staying fit with a sports premium, ergonomics consulting, healthy nutrition and other health initiatives.

Development

Learning is written GREAT with us. For personal and professional development, you have various exciting possibilities at your disposal.

Mobility

We support you with a monthly mobility bonus and e-bikes on site. You can also benefit from the REKA card.

Family friendly environment - correctly insured

Our social security benefits, as well as maternity leave, go far beyond the mandatory - for your own protection and for your loved ones.

Flexibility

Depending on the function, flexible working hours, home office and part-time work are possible. We also offer you the option to increase the holiday days.

Benefits

Numerous discounts such as a top staff restaurant, discounts in the Lindt shops or great leisure activities are available.
descriptionByLocale.de:

Was du bei uns machst:

- Konzeptionelle Verantwortung für MWST-relevante unternehmens- und produktspezifische Prozesse im In- und Ausland (u. a. in den Bereichen Domestic, Retail, Intercompany, Global Travel Retail und internationale Distributoren)

- Prüfung von elektronischen Veranlagungsverfügungen sowie BAZG-Rechnungen

- Fachliche Unterstützung bei abteilungsübergreifenden Projekten und Prozessen (inkl. Umsetzung im SAP)
- Erstellung von Auswertungen und Statistiken für periodische Abschlüsse (Monats- und Jahresabschluss) sowie Mitarbeit bei Audits
- Überwachung und Weiterentwicklung der MWST-Prozesse inkl. Pflege und Aktualisierung der Prozess- und IKS-Dokumentationen

Wann du zu uns passt:

- Kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung im Bereich Finanz- und Rechnungswesen (z. B. Fachausweis)
- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung mit Schwerpunkt MWST
- Sehr gute SAP-Kenntnisse und ausgeprägtes Prozessverständnis
- Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und hohe Eigeninitiative
- Teamfähigkeit sowie starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

Wir sind alle einzigartig!

Wir rekrutieren frei von Vorurteilen und berücksichtigen Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen unbeeinflusst von persönlichen Merkmalen wie Geschlecht, Alter, sexuelle Orientierung, Herkunft, Religion, Familienstand, Beeinträchtigungen, etc.

Wohlbefinden

Gesundheit ist uns wichtig. Mit einer Sportprämie, Ergonomieberatung, gesunder Ernährung und weiteren Gesundheitsinitiativen unterstützen wir dich dabei fit zu bleiben.

Entwicklung

Lernen wird bei uns GROSS geschrieben. Für die persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung stehen dir verschiedene spannende Möglichkeiten zur Verfügung.

Mobilität

Wir unterstützen dich mit einer monatlichen Mobilitätsprämie und E-Bikes vor Ort. Zudem kannst du auch von der REKA-Card profitieren.

Familienfreundliches Umfeld - richtig versichert

Unsere Sozialversicherungen, wie auch der Mutterschaftsurlaub, gehen weit über das Obligatorische hinaus - zum eigenen Schutz sowie für deine Liebsten.

Flexibilität

Je nach Funktion sind flexible Arbeitszeiten, Home Office sowie Teilzeitarbeit möglich. Zudem bieten wir dir die Option, die Ferientage zu erhöhen.

Vergünstigung

Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen wie ein top Personalrestaurant, Rabatte in den Lindt Shops oder tolle Freizeitangebote stehen dir zur Verfügung.

A Altendorf, nous exploitons notre propre centre logistique, tandis que le Lindt Cocoa Center à Olten produit une masse de cacao pour nos propres besoins ainsi que pour d'autres installations de production européennes.

Plus de 1000 employés de plus de 50 pays contribuent à notre succès.

Ce que vous faites de nous :

- Responsabilité conceptuelle des entreprises et des processus spécifiques à chaque produit en matière de TVA au pays et à l'étranger (y compris

- la préparation des factures de TVA en Suisse et à l'étranger (Suisse, Belgique) et la mise en œuvre des accords de vente et de pré-taxe - la coordination avec les prestataires externes de services de TVA en ce qui concerne le recouvrement des paiements pré-impôt en provenance de pays tiers - la personne-ressource pour les contrôles de TVA (contrôle technique, traitement des données, etc.) - la détermination des taux de TVA pour le calcul des marchandises - l'examen des commandes électroniques et des factures BAZG - la responsabilité de la

Fourniture d'indicateurs statistiques aux autorités - Appui technique aux projets et processus interdépartementaux (incl.

Mise en œuvre dans le cadre du programme SAP) - Élaboration d'évaluations et de statistiques pour les états financiers sahraouis (comptes mensuels et annuels) et coopération avec les audits - Suivi et développement des processus de TVA, y compris la tenue et la mise à jour des processus et des documents du SIC

Quand vous vous installez avec nous:

- Formation commerciale avec une formation complémentaire en comptabilité et en finances (par exemple carte spécialisée) - Expérience pluriannuelle en comptabilité financière avec un accent sur la TVA - Très bonnes compétences SAP et une bonne compréhension du processus - Bonnes compétences en anglais en écriture et en parole - Indépendants, méthodes de travail structurées et haute initiative - Compétences d'équipe et compétences en communication

Nous sommes tous uniques!

Bien-être

La santé est importante pour nous. Nous vous soutenons dans votre maintien en forme avec une prime sportive, des conseils ergonomiques, une nutrition saine et d'autres initiatives de santé.

Développement

L'apprentissage est écrit GRAND avec nous. Pour le développement personnel et professionnel, vous avez diverses possibilités passionnantes à votre disposition.

Mobilité

Nous vous accompagnons avec un bonus mensuel de mobilité et des vélos électroniques sur place. Vous pouvez également bénéficier de la carte REKA.

Environnement familial - correctement assuré

Nos prestations de sécurité sociale, ainsi que le congé de maternité, vont bien au-delà de l'obligation - pour votre propre protection et pour vos proches.

Flexibilité
